chapterTransition.ch01: All five trail memories collected — next stop, home in the bamboo grove.
chapterTransition.ch02: The warm bamboo-grove moments are tucked away — time to meet the neighborhood cats.
chapterTransition.ch03: Yarn balls and cat ears, all collected — time for a walk through the flower fields.
chapterTransition.ch04: Flower crown on — the bakery down the road smells amazing.
chapterTransition.ch05: Cake finished — pick up a paintbrush and paint a whole new world.
chapterTransition.ch06: Palette packed away — the ocean is sparkling in the distance.
chapterTransition.ch07: Diving gear off, backpack on — time to see the world's landmarks.
chapterTransition.ch08: Map folded up — the stars in the night sky are calling.
chapterTransition.ch09: Stars collected — the city lights are starting to glow.
chapterTransition.ch10: All 10 journeys complete! The panda's album now holds 50 memories. Thanks for coming along.
